labeling: executed_by_candidate = run in this stage's isolated python_execute sandbox with receipts; UNEXECUTED = proposed only, designed but never run.
scope_warning: All executed items are isolated component checks on synthetic data. They do not establish behavior of any complete application, nor of third-party tools (napari/QuPath/tifffile/OpenSlide).

executed.title: Stored-coordinate precision and transform composition order
executed.label: executed by candidate
executed.input: synthetic coordinate values; stage origin 100000.0 um, pixel size 0.101 um, index 1234; S=(2,2), T=(10,0), p=(2,3)
executed.justified_expected: Python float (IEEE-754 double) round-trips exactly through JSON (shortest-repr guarantee); routing the same computation through float32 loses precision proportional to the large origin; scale-then-translate differs from translate-then-scale, so composition order is information that must be recorded.
executed.scope_limits: pure-Python arithmetic on synthetic values; no real image/JSON project files; supports the storage decision (float64 + JSON shortest-repr + recorded order), does not measure any product.

executed.title: Axis-order ambiguity discrimination
executed.label: executed by candidate
executed.input: synthetic 16-sample acquisition, C-major 'CZ' writer layout (C=2, Z=2, Y=1, X=1, value=10*c+z); two reader interpretations CZ vs ZC; query (c=1, z=0)
executed.justified_expected: Both readings are internally consistent with the same stored sequence, so the query returns different samples (10 vs 1): axis order cannot be inferred from bytes; it must be explicit metadata (the failure class NGFF axes metadata and the tifffile #334 metadata-type regression speak to).
executed.scope_limits: synthetic layout; demonstrates the ambiguity class only, not any specific vendor file.

executed.title: Atomic save via temp + os.replace; interrupted-save recovery
executed.label: executed by candidate
executed.input: sandbox tempdir; project.json rev1; simulated crash mid-write of temp file (partial JSON, no rename); then clean rewrite of temp + os.replace
executed.justified_expected: After an interrupted save the previous complete state remains readable; the stale partial temp file is detectable; a completed save atomically replaces the old file and removes the temp name (POSIX rename semantics).
executed.scope_limits: Linux sandbox filesystem only; no concurrent readers, no fsync/power-loss simulation, no Windows rename semantics; validates the mechanism, not the application.

executed.title: Source identity by sha256+size; relocation and relink
executed.label: executed by candidate
executed.input: sandbox tempdir; 73,728-byte synthetic source; copy to renamed path with forced older mtime; original removed; whole-tree relink search by size+sha256
executed.justified_expected: Content hash+size survive rename, relocation and mtime change; path is a hint and mtime is not identity; relink-by-content finds the moved file after the original path disappears.
executed.superseded: exec-8zodkcc4 (first run) checked original-missing before the removal and reported false; retained here for transparency, superseded by this corrected run.
executed.scope_limits: synthetic small file; hashing full contents at import is the proposed production behavior but its cost on multi-GB files is unmeasured (see P1).

proposed_unexecuted.title: 3 GB bounded-access benchmark
proposed_unexecuted.design: On the 8-core/16 GB envelope, open a >=3 GB tiled OME-TIFF through the planned tile source; measure peak RSS (<~6 GB target), time-to-first-plane (<2 s warm), pan/zoom jitter (<100 ms warm), cancel latency (<250 ms) during bulk prefetch.
proposed_unexecuted.status: UNEXECUTED - no real large file was available to this stage; the brief's 3 GB envelope remains an engineering target.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Crash-recovery suite
proposed_unexecuted.design: kill -9 during manifest save, import hashing, and export; relaunch must yield last complete manifest + journal replay per proposal 5.5; includes P2c: verify os.replace-over-existing semantics on Windows before shipping.
proposed_unexecuted.status: UNEXECUTED - W3 covers only the clean POSIX mechanism.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Second-machine reopen
proposed_unexecuted.design: Copy project directory + relocate sources on a second machine; app must relink by sha256+size or enter explicit quarantine; annotations and view state must round-trip byte-identically in the index frame.
proposed_unexecuted.status: UNEXECUTED - W4 demonstrates only the identity/relink primitive.

proposed_unexecuted.title: NGFF export round-trip
proposed_unexecuted.design: Export an image + label store as OME-NGFF 0.4 and read it back with an independent reader (e.g. ome-zarr-py); axes order, per-level scale, translation, and window metadata must match the manifest within double precision.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Export coordinate spot-check
proposed_unexecuted.design: Compare this tool's annotation-table export coordinates against a QuPath GeoJSON export of the same ROI on the same image; both claim full-resolution pixel units with top-left origin (QuPath docs S10); disagreement diagnoses an origin/units bug.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Plane-scoped operation property test
proposed_unexecuted.design: Property test: any geometric op (split/subtract/clip) applied to annotations with mixed (z,t) anchors must not alter annotations on other planes (the QuPath #1729 failure class).
